cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Courtesy, cooperation and identifying other … share the road safely.”
cards.back: Courtesy, cooperation and identifying other users help drivers share the road safely.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A person becomes a pedestrian … follow pedestrian traffic rules.”
cards.back: A person becomes a pedestrian after leaving a vehicle and must follow pedestrian traffic rules.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Pedestrians should use a sidewalk … side facing approaching traffic.”
cards.back: Pedestrians should use a sidewalk when available; without one, walk along the left side facing approaching traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “At night, pedestrians should improve … clothing and reflective material.”
cards.back: At night, pedestrians should improve visibility with a flashlight, light-colored clothing and reflective material.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A pedestrian facing WALK or … and stop before crossing.”
cards.back: A pedestrian facing WALK or green should still confirm that drivers see the pedestrian and stop before crossing.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not begin crossing against … the crossing, finish crossing.”
cards.back: Do not begin crossing against DON'T WALK, red or yellow; if flashing DON'T WALK begins during the crossing, finish crossing.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Pedestrians should make eye contact … assume they will yield.”
cards.back: Pedestrians should make eye contact with slowing or stopped drivers rather than assume they will yield.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Stop for a pedestrian crossing … that crossing is unlawful.”
cards.back: Stop for a pedestrian crossing outside a crosswalk even when that crossing is unlawful.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Yield to pedestrians in crosswalks, … street at an intersection.”
cards.back: Yield to pedestrians in crosswalks, including unmarked crossings where sidewalks meet a street at an intersection.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Yield at a marked midblock … at a corner crossing.”
cards.back: Yield at a marked midblock crossing just as at a corner crossing.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Stop completely for a crossing … dog or white cane.”
cards.back: Stop completely for a crossing pedestrian using a guide dog or white cane.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A green light does not … already in the intersection.”
cards.back: A green light does not remove the duty to yield to pedestrians already in the intersection.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Before a left turn or … with a green arrow.”
cards.back: Before a left turn or U-turn, search for pedestrians even with a green arrow.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “For a right turn, particularly … from the vehicle's right.”
cards.back: For a right turn, particularly on red, watch pedestrians approaching from the vehicle's right.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Before passing a stopped vehicle, … including on multilane roads.”
cards.back: Before passing a stopped vehicle, slow and confirm that no pedestrian is crossing ahead of it, including on multilane roads.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Check for pedestrians before backing, … such as shopping centers.”
cards.back: Check for pedestrians before backing, especially in busy pedestrian areas such as shopping centers.
cards.memory_hook: Check the view before moving.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Near schools, playgrounds and homes, … and prepare to stop.”
cards.back: Near schools, playgrounds and homes, expect children to emerge between parked vehicles; slow and prepare to stop.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Obey the reduced school-zone speed … a school patrol's signal.”
cards.back: Obey the reduced school-zone speed when lights flash or children are present, and stop for a school patrol's signal.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “On the roadway, cyclists have … must follow traffic rules.”
cards.back: On the roadway, cyclists have the rights and responsibilities of vehicle users and must follow traffic rules.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Be ready for unexpected bicycle … be difficult to see.”
cards.back: Be ready for unexpected bicycle movement because riders differ in skill and may be difficult to see.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Cyclists should ride on the … traffic signs and signals.”
cards.back: Cyclists should ride on the road's right side and obey traffic signs and signals.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Cyclists use hand signals to … communicate their intended movement.”
cards.back: Cyclists use hand signals to communicate their intended movement.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A cyclist may use the … obstructs the riding path.”
cards.back: A cyclist may use the whole lane when debris, cracks, parked vehicles or another hazard obstructs the riding path.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A cyclist may use the … making a left turn.”
cards.back: A cyclist may use the middle or left roadway position for traveling straight through an intersection or making a left turn.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “The handbook permits cyclists to … single-file riding is preferable.”
cards.back: The handbook permits cyclists to ride two abreast in a lane, while recognizing situations where single-file riding is preferable.
cards.memory_hook: Keep the licensing path distinct.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Cyclists should wear bright clothing … bicycle in good repair.”
cards.back: Cyclists should wear bright clothing and reflectors and keep the bicycle in good repair.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A bicycle headlight is required … taillight for added visibility.”
cards.back: A bicycle headlight is required at dusk; the handbook strongly recommends a taillight for added visibility.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Yield to a cyclist where … lane crosses a road.”
cards.back: Yield to a cyclist where a bicycle path or lane crosses a road.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not stop, park or … or address an emergency.”
cards.back: Do not stop, park or drive in a designated bike path or lane except to enter or leave an alley or driveway, perform official duties, follow police direction or address an emergency.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “When approaching or passing a … consider the rider's speed.”
cards.back: When approaching or passing a cyclist, slow, leave generous space and consider the rider's speed.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not pass a cyclist … clear the intersection first.”
cards.back: Do not pass a cyclist immediately before turning right; slow and let the rider clear the intersection first.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “After passing a cyclist, avoid … cause a rear-end collision.”
cards.back: After passing a cyclist, avoid an abrupt slowdown or stop that could cause a rear-end collision.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not sound the horn … startled rider may swerve.”
cards.back: Do not sound the horn close to a cyclist unless a collision risk requires it; a startled rider may swerve.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “When turning, watch for cyclists … riding from a sidewalk.”
cards.back: When turning, watch for cyclists entering the lane, especially children riding from a sidewalk.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not turn sharply across … cyclist off the road.”
cards.back: Do not turn sharply across a cyclist's path or force the cyclist off the road.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Although cyclists should follow traffic … anywhere on the roadway.”
cards.back: Although cyclists should follow traffic direction, drivers should search for them anywhere on the roadway.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Wet pavement, sand and gravel … requiring additional caution nearby.”
cards.back: Wet pavement, sand and gravel impair bicycle braking and turning, requiring additional caution nearby.
cards.memory_hook: Check readiness before driving.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A cyclist may need both … for other intent clues.”
cards.back: A cyclist may need both hands for control and be unable to signal; watch head movements and shoulder checks for other intent clues.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Before opening a parked vehicle's … cyclists and other traffic.”
cards.back: Before opening a parked vehicle's door, check beside and behind for cyclists and other traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “The handbook's Dutch Reach example … toward approaching rear traffic.”
cards.back: The handbook's Dutch Reach example uses the right hand on the door handle to turn the body toward approaching rear traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Keep the test condition attached.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Check for cyclists before backing, … schools and residential areas.”
cards.back: Check for cyclists before backing, with extra attention near schools and residential areas.
cards.memory_hook: Check the view before moving.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A sharrow combines a bicycle … within a shared lane.”
cards.back: A sharrow combines a bicycle image with two chevrons and recommends a bicycle's position within a shared lane.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A bike lane designates roadway … a solid white boundary.”
cards.back: A bike lane designates roadway space for bicycles, commonly near the right edge and marked with a solid white boundary.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A bike lane does not … make a left turn.”
cards.back: A bike lane does not prevent a cyclist leaving it to avoid a collision, continue straight through an intersection or make a left turn.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

decks.module: Bike routes and small motorized vehicles

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Bike routes or bikeways recommend … roads, for bicycle travel.”
cards.back: Bike routes or bikeways recommend lower-traffic roads, often neighborhood or side roads, for bicycle travel.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Motorcycle, scooter and moped riders … responsibilities as other drivers.”
cards.back: Motorcycle, scooter and moped riders have the same traffic rights and responsibilities as other drivers.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Motorcycles, scooters and mopeds may … may share a lane.”
cards.back: Motorcycles, scooters and mopeds may use a full lane, and two such vehicles may share a lane.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not pass a motorcycle, … within the same lane.”
cards.back: Do not pass a motorcycle, scooter or moped within the same lane.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Check mirrors and turn the … moves and at intersections.”
cards.back: Check mirrors and turn the head to search blind spots for small motorized riders before lane moves and at intersections.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “The handbook defines a motorized … thirty miles per hour”
cards.back: The handbook defines a motorized bicycle or moped as a two-tandem-wheel or three-wheel device powered by a person, helper motor or both, with all four features: at most three point five brake horsepower, at most one hundred thirty cubic centimeters, automatic transmission and a design-speed maximum of thirty miles per hour
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not assume a motorcycle, … until the turn begins.”
cards.back: Do not assume a motorcycle, scooter or moped will turn merely because its signal flashes; wait until the turn begins.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Signals on small motorized vehicles … so leave maneuvering space.”
cards.back: Signals on small motorized vehicles may not self-cancel, and some such vehicles may lack signals, so leave maneuvering space.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Signal before merging or changing … can anticipate the movement.”
cards.back: Signal before merging or changing lanes so riders can anticipate the movement.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Expect riders to change speed … seams, tracks or grooves.”
cards.back: Expect riders to change speed or position around potholes, gravel, slick surfaces, pavement seams, tracks or grooves.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “When following a motorcycle, scooter … space in wet conditions.”
cards.back: When following a motorcycle, scooter or moped, allow three to four seconds, with more space in wet conditions.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Dim high beams when approaching … avoid dazzling the rider.”
cards.back: Dim high beams when approaching a motorcycle, scooter or moped to avoid dazzling the rider.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “When a rider passes, maintain … interfering with the pass.”
cards.back: When a rider passes, maintain lane position and speed without accelerating or interfering with the pass.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Scooters and mopeds generally travel … more slowly than motorcycles.”
cards.back: Scooters and mopeds generally travel more slowly than motorcycles.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “During an emergency, emergency-vehicle drivers … other road users' safety.”
cards.back: During an emergency, emergency-vehicle drivers may have traffic-control exemptions but must still consider other road users' safety.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “For an approaching siren or … and keep intersections clear.”
cards.back: For an approaching siren or flashing emergency lights, move right, stop parallel close to the curb or edge, and keep intersections clear.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “After an emergency vehicle passes, … traffic only when safe.”
cards.back: After an emergency vehicle passes, check behind for others and rejoin traffic only when safe.
cards.memory_hook: Check the view before moving.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “In its emergency-vehicle passage instructions, … from the emergency vehicle.”
cards.back: In its emergency-vehicle passage instructions, the handbook requires staying at least five hundred feet from the emergency vehicle.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Stop for an emergency vehicle … clear of the path.”
cards.back: Stop for an emergency vehicle entering or leaving its garage with lights flashing until it is safely clear of the path.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “At an emergency scene, follow … enforcement and emergency-service personnel.”
cards.back: At an emergency scene, follow the directions of law enforcement and emergency-service personnel.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “For a police stop, pull … the driver and officer.”
cards.back: For a police stop, pull right and as far outside traffic as safely possible for both the driver and officer.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “During a traffic stop, switch … the window to communicate.”
cards.back: During a traffic stop, switch off the engine and distracting audio or devices, activate hazard lights and lower the window to communicate.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “At night during a traffic … officer can see inside.”
cards.back: At night during a traffic stop, turn on the interior light so the officer can see inside.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Remain calm with seat belts … to do the same.”
cards.back: Remain calm with seat belts fastened during a traffic stop, and ask passengers to do the same.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Keep hands on the wheel … during a police stop.”
cards.back: Keep hands on the wheel and minimize movements during a police stop.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “When asked for license, insurance … hand on the wheel.”
cards.back: When asked for license, insurance or registration, tell the officer where the documents are and reach slowly while keeping one hand on the wheel.
cards.memory_hook: Match documents to the application.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Remain inside during a traffic … answer the officer clearly.”
cards.back: Remain inside during a traffic stop unless asked to exit, and answer the officer clearly.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not flee law enforcement; … create serious crash risks.”
cards.back: Do not flee law enforcement; police pursuits create serious crash risks.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “When approaching a stationary same-direction … weather and road conditions.”
cards.back: When approaching a stationary same-direction emergency vehicle with flashing lights, including a tow or recovery vehicle, leave the adjacent lane if safe and possible; otherwise slow appropriately for traffic, weather and road conditions.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Large vehicles maneuver less readily, … turning space than cars.”
cards.back: Large vehicles maneuver less readily, have larger blind spots and need longer stopping and acceleration distances and more turning space than cars.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

decks.module: Truck blind areas and following space

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “The No-Zone consists of blind … large trucks or buses.”
cards.back: The No-Zone consists of blind areas at the front, rear and sides of large trucks or buses.
cards.memory_hook: Check the view before moving.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A truck's right-side blind area … along the truck's length.”
cards.back: A truck's right-side blind area starts behind the cab and can extend along the truck's length.
cards.memory_hook: Check the view before moving.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “The handbook uses inability to … see the following vehicle.”
cards.back: The handbook uses inability to see the truck driver's face in a side mirror as a warning that the driver cannot see the following vehicle.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Avoid remaining beside a large … can create a collision.”
cards.back: Avoid remaining beside a large vehicle longer than needed because a lane change or swerve can create a collision.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “The handbook's loaded-truck example at … thirty-five feet to stop.”
cards.back: The handbook's loaded-truck example at fifty-five miles per hour, with good tires, correctly adjusted brakes and ideal conditions, requires at least three hundred thirty-five feet to stop.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “After passing a large vehicle, … it, and maintain speed.”
cards.back: After passing a large vehicle, wait until its full front appears in the rearview mirror before moving ahead of it, and maintain speed.
cards.memory_hook: Check the view before moving.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Large-vehicle rear blind spots can … following driver's forward view.”
cards.back: Large-vehicle rear blind spots can extend as much as two hundred feet; close following also blocks the following driver's forward view.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Follow large vehicles with room … in their side mirrors.”
cards.back: Follow large vehicles with room to react and a position visible in their side mirrors.
cards.memory_hook: Check the view before moving.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “When possible, avoid the right … trucks reenter faster traffic.”
cards.back: When possible, avoid the right lane near truck weigh stations where slow trucks reenter faster traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A truck or bus may … more than one lane.”
cards.back: A truck or bus may swing left before a right turn and need space from more than one lane.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not squeeze between a … to finish before turning.”
cards.back: Do not squeeze between a turning truck or bus and the curb; wait for its turn to finish before turning.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “When meeting an opposing truck, … sideswipe and turbulence risks.”
cards.back: When meeting an opposing truck, leave as much right-side clearance as possible to reduce sideswipe and turbulence risks.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “If uncertain about an opposing … left across its path.”
cards.back: If uncertain about an opposing truck or bus's speed, do not turn left across its path.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Stop behind intersection stop lines, … room for large vehicles.”
cards.back: Stop behind intersection stop lines, which also preserve turning room for large vehicles.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not cut off a … or single-lane work area.”
cards.back: Do not cut off a truck to reach a turn, exit or single-lane work area.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Runaway ramps on long descents … stop or park there.”
cards.back: Runaway ramps on long descents are reserved for large vehicles that cannot stop or have lost control; do not stop or park there.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A stopped transit bus may … boarding and exiting passengers.”
cards.back: A stopped transit bus may hide pedestrians or be about to reenter traffic; watch boarding and exiting passengers.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A transit safety zone protects … park in the zone.”
cards.back: A transit safety zone protects people boarding, leaving or waiting for rail transit; do not drive through or park in the zone.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Pass a transit safety zone … ten miles per hour”
cards.back: Pass a transit safety zone only when safe and at no more than ten miles per hour
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Without a safety zone, stop … until they reach safety.”
cards.back: Without a safety zone, stop behind the nearest trolley or light-rail door or platform while people board or leave, and wait until they reach safety.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not pass a moving … by a traffic officer.”
cards.back: Do not pass a moving or stopped trolley or light-rail vehicle on the left except on a one-way street, where tracks prevent right-side passing, or when directed by a traffic officer.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Let an approaching trolley or … turning across its path.”
cards.back: Let an approaching trolley or light-rail vehicle pass before turning across its path.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Buildings, trees and other obstructions … a rail operator's view.”
cards.back: Buildings, trees and other obstructions can restrict a rail operator's view.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “When sharing a roadway with … preserve safe following space.”
cards.back: When sharing a roadway with a trolley or light-rail vehicle, preserve safe following space.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “An orange-and-red reflective or fluorescent … twenty-five miles per hour”
cards.back: An orange-and-red reflective or fluorescent triangle on the rear of a slow vehicle indicates travel below twenty-five miles per hour
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Approach slow-moving vehicles cautiously and … pass only when safe.”
cards.back: Approach slow-moving vehicles cautiously and pass only when safe.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Rural farm equipment may cross … because of its width.”
cards.back: Rural farm equipment may cross roads or occupy more than one lane because of its width.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Farm equipment may lack turn … movement predicts the turn.”
cards.back: Farm equipment may lack turn signals and swing left before turning right; do not assume its initial movement predicts the turn.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Farm machines commonly travel below … caution when passing them.”
cards.back: Farm machines commonly travel below twenty-five miles per hour; use caution when passing them.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Animal-drawn vehicles share road rights … duties with motor vehicles.”
cards.back: Animal-drawn vehicles share road rights and traffic-rule duties with motor vehicles.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Animal-drawn vehicles normally travel about … equipment or crossing intersections.”
cards.back: Animal-drawn vehicles normally travel about five to eight miles per hour and may be slower while hauling farm equipment or crossing intersections.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A large load can obstruct … pass with extra care.”
cards.back: A large load can obstruct an animal-drawn vehicle driver's rear view; pass with extra care.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not honk or rev … can cause a crash.”
cards.back: Do not honk or rev the engine near animal-drawn traffic because a frightened horse can cause a crash.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Anticipate animal-drawn vehicles turning left … into fields or driveways.”
cards.back: Anticipate animal-drawn vehicles turning left into fields or driveways.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Horse riders should travel single … shoulder, lane or path.”
cards.back: Horse riders should travel single file near the right edge or on a usable right shoulder, lane or path.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Approach or pass a ridden … horn or engine noise.”
cards.back: Approach or pass a ridden or led horse at a reasonable speed and distance without loud horn or engine noise.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A slow-vehicle driver causing others … to let them pass.”
cards.back: A slow-vehicle driver causing others to slow should pull aside when safe to let them pass.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.
